name: Raven Marked
body:
Being marked as a bad omen has granted you affinity with curses.

Prerequisite(s): Ability to cast a spell with the curse descriptor.

Benefit(s): Whenever a creature fails a saving throw against a spell you cast with the curse descriptor that applies a numeric penalty, such as bestow curse, increase that penalty by 1.
